mapper.insert: INSERT INTO hyperlink_task_account_stat (hyperlink_task_id, account_id, send_total, success_num, delivered_num, read_num, failed_num, fail_404_num, first_send_at, last_send_at, created_at, updated_at, reconciled_at) SELECT #{taskId}, account_id, SUM(CASE WHEN submitted_at IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), SUM(CASE WHEN send_status BETWEEN 3 AND 5 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), SUM(CASE WHEN send_status BETWEEN 4 AND 5 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), SUM(CASE WHEN send_status=5 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), SUM(CASE WHEN send_status IN (6,7) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), SUM(CASE WHEN send_status=7 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), MIN(submitted_at), MAX(submitted_at), #{now}, #{now}, #{now} FROM hyperlink_task_recipient WHERE hyperlink_task_id=#{taskId} GROUP BY account_id ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE send_total=VALUES(send_total), success_num=VALUES(success_num), delivered_num=VALUES(delivered_num), read_num=VALUES(read_num), failed_num=VALUES(failed_num), fail_404_num=VALUES(fail_404_num), first_send_at=VALUES(first_send_at), last_send_at=VALUES(last_send_at), updated_at=VALUES(updated_at), reconciled_at=VALUES(reconciled_at)

INSERT INTO hyperlink_task_account_stat (tenant_id, hyperlink_task_id, account_id, send_total, success_num, delivered_num, read_num, failed_num, fail_404_num, first_send_at, last_send_at, created_at, updated_at) VALUES
(#{delta.tenantId}, #{delta.taskId}, #{delta.accountId}, #{delta.sendDelta}, #{delta.successDelta}, #{delta.deliveredDelta}, #{delta.readDelta}, #{delta.failedDelta}, #{delta.fail404Delta}, #{delta.firstSendAt}, #{delta.lastSendAt}, #{now}, #{now})
ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE send_total=send_total+VALUES(send_total), success_num=success_num+VALUES(success_num), delivered_num=delivered_num+VALUES(delivered_num), read_num=read_num+VALUES(read_num), failed_num=failed_num+VALUES(failed_num), fail_404_num=fail_404_num+VALUES(fail_404_num), first_send_at=CASE WHEN VALUES(first_send_at) IS NULL THEN first_send_at WHEN first_send_at IS NULL THEN VALUES(first_send_at) ELSE LEAST(first_send_at,VALUES(first_send_at)) END, last_send_at=CASE WHEN VALUES(last_send_at) IS NULL THEN last_send_at WHEN last_send_at IS NULL THEN VALUES(last_send_at) ELSE GREATEST(last_send_at,VALUES(last_send_at)) END, updated_at=VALUES(updated_at)
